premises.text: The Nigerian education system does not prepare graduates for today's job market
premises.evidence_span: The Nigerian education system did not prepare me for today's job market.

premises.text: A significant number of graduates remain unemployed due to a skills gap
There is a rising demand for technical skills in Africa
premises.evidence_span: Opportunities in tech keep rising and it is inevitable.

premises.text: Old School Africa provides innovative content for Africans made by Africans
premises.evidence_span: Old School Africa is solving this problem through providing innovative content for Africans made by Africans.

premises.text: The learning program includes structured learning, soft skill training, mentorship, and internship
premises.evidence_span: you gain access to nine months of structured learning, soft skill training, mentorship, and three months of internship.

premises.text: Old School Africa offers a cost-effective alternative to traditional coding bootcamps
premises.evidence_span: Old School Africa is a short, hard, cost-effective way towards accessing online education.

premises.text: The program is accessible to anyone with an SSE certificate
premises.evidence_span: it's accessible to anyone who has an SSE certificate.

premises.text: The business model includes an application fee and income-sharing agreements
premises.evidence_span: We accept an application fee of $20... they can also access education for free until they are done.

premises.text: The program aims to support students from the start of their education to becoming professionals
premises.evidence_span: the goal is how can we ensure that from the moment you join the all school program, from the day you start coding, till the day you become a CTO.

premises.text: The program is designed to be inclusive for all Africans, not just English speakers
premises.evidence_span: The all school program is for every African, not just English-speaking Africans.

value.text: Every African can access technical skills and opportunities in the job market
value.evidence_span: It is for anyone who is looking for an easy way to transition into tech.

notes: Traction metrics and specific partnerships excluded as they do not support premises.
